tasks.design: Configure native library search and reference formatting in reference management software {OTHER}, with source links in {DOCS}. The teacher checks originals and chooses readings, then fully checks the formatted bibliography before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bibliographies can repeat source discovery and citation formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search and exact verified metadata formatting can reduce manual production.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate reading selection requires scholarly and teaching judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises a reading that is influential but unsuitable for the actual course.
tasks.altitude: Less citation production; scholarly selection stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reference tools can format verified publication metadata; they do not establish source existence or choose suitable readings.

assumptions: Actual publishers/library owners supply author, title, year, edition and identifier metadata; teacher verifies it in s1 and chooses actual materials in s2. Missing metadata is captured manually in retained source checking, never invented.
S3 formats already verified chosen metadata only. Existing reference formatting earns zero saving; original reading, selection and complete final source checks remain retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native citation tools first. Save retains one percent using existing final check. Actual LMS publication or student delivery would be its own exact-final-version gated action if included.
unknowns: How much citation formatting remains manual?
research_questions: Can native formatting reduce production after complete identity/edition checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual reference style and source metadata checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual bibliography and exact course-document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 discovery navigation + 25 citation formatting = 35; minus 1 upkeep = 34. Half eligible gives 17.5 minus 1 = 16.5. Scholarly selection, full check and save retained.

tasks.design: Configure native committee agenda/policy links in {DOCS} and {PROJECT}. The teacher retains substantive preparation, actual deliberation and any actual assigned note capture/check before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Committee preparation can repeat agenda/policy navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-paper links can shorten retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Institutional decisions require collegial deliberation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises consequences for students or departments absent from a standard summary.
tasks.altitude: Less committee lookup; deliberation stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native agenda/policy links can support committee preparation; they do not deliberate or determine institutional policy.

assumptions: Actual committee/policy owners supply agenda and current papers; teacher checks sources in s1. Substantive reading and actual committee contribution remain retained.

S3/s4 apply only to actual assigned notes/actions, not mandatory minutes per attendee. If no teacher-owned record exists remove branch and reweight; chair/secretary work is not invented as focal labour.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing paper access earns zero saving. Routine save retains one percent using existing final check. Any actual distribution or formal vote/approval record is its own exact-final-content action; no avoided labour assumed.

tasks.design: Configure native funding/source links and proposal fields in {PARTNER_PORTAL} and {DOCS}, using actual budget work in {SPREADSHEET}. Bound narrative drafting to actual research decisions; retain complete scientific/budget review before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Grant writing can repeat source navigation and prose after research choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source/field reuse and bounded drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: A credible economics research design and feasible budget require scholarly judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises an identification claim unsupported by the available data.
tasks.altitude: Less grant prose; research design stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native funding/source fields and bounded drafting can support grant preparation; they do not establish economic research validity or funding success.

assumptions: Actual funder/institution supplies call/rules and finance supplies actual rates. Teacher checks sources in s1 and captures research design, quantities and actual budget in s2; no free structured research plan.
Retained s3 includes actual narrative meaning capture/correction; full final scientific/budget checking remains in s4. Native fields first; existing proposal automation earns zero saving.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Save retains one percent using existing final check. Task writes proposals; any actual institutional approval and funder submission require separate exact-final-version approval/send, with no avoided approval labour or assumed funding result.
